title: Fantasy Island Map
description: A vibrant cartoon-style map of a tropical fantasy island featuring a shipwreck on rocky shores, a river with wooden bridges, a village of mushroom-shaped houses, a circus tent, a pirate ship, a waterfall, and a glowing portal in a lagoon. Snow-capped mountains and an archway gate appear in the distant background under a purple sky.
